title: A bill to release the City of St. Clair, Missouri, from all restrictions, conditions, and limitations on the use, encumbrance, conveyance, and closure of the St. Clair Regional Airport.
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Directs the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) to release the city of St. Clair, Missouri, from all restrictions on the use, encumbrance, conveyance, and closure of the St. Clair Regional Airport.

Prohibits such release from being executed before the city transfers to the Missouri Department of Transportation: (1) specified amounts to be used for capital improvements for airport development consistent with such Department's obligations under the FAA's state block grant program; and (2) for no consideration, all airport and aviation-related equipment of the Airport owned by the city and determined to be salvageable.

Describes such specified amounts as: (1) the fair market value for the highest and best use of the Airport property; (2) the unamortized portion of any federal development grants other than land paid to the city for use at the airport, which may be paid with, and shall be an allowable use of, airport revenue; and (3) the airport revenues remaining in the Airport's account and otherwise due to or received by the city.

Directs the FAA to remove the runway end indicator lighting system at the Airport.

summary.headline: Congress directed the FAA to release St. Clair, Missouri from federal restrictions on its regional airport, conditioned on the city making specified payments and transfers to the state transportation department.
summary.what_it_does: The law requires the Federal Aviation Administration to lift the federal limits on how St. Clair uses, sells, transfers, or closes the St. Clair Regional Airport. The release cannot happen until the city transfers certain money to the Missouri Department of Transportation, including funds for airport capital improvements, and gives over salvageable airport equipment at no cost. The money covers the fair market value of the airport property, the unpaid part of certain federal development grants, and leftover airport revenue. The law also directs the FAA to remove the airport's runway end indicator lighting system.

who_it_affects.how: The city is freed from federal restrictions on the airport but must first transfer specified funds and salvageable equipment to the Missouri Department of Transportation.
The state agency receives the required payments and equipment and must use the capital-improvement funds for airport development under the FAA's state block grant program.

who_it_affects.group: Users of the St. Clair Regional Airport
who_it_affects.how: The airport's runway end indicator lighting system is to be removed, and the airport's future use or closure is no longer governed by federal restrictions.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted December 18, 2014; the FAA release may not be carried out until the city completes the required transfers.
